question: What is the range of the supersonic Akash missile?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Around 25 km**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The range of the supersonic Akash missile is **around 25 km**.
 
• The Akash missile is a medium-range surface-to-air missile (SAM) system developed by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) in India.
 
• It is capable of engaging aerial threats such as fighter jets, cruise missiles, and air-to-surface missiles.
 
• The missile system has a multi-target engagement capability, which enhances its effectiveness in combat scenarios.
 
• Akash is an integral part of India's defense strategy and has been deployed by the Indian Army and Air Force.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Akash missile system is designed to provide air defense against aerial threats in all weather conditions.
 
• It is equipped with a high-explosive, pre-fragmented warhead and has a command guidance system.
 
• The system includes a launcher, a control center, a multi-function radar, and support vehicles, making it a comprehensive air defense solution.
 
• Akash has undergone several successful tests and has been inducted into the Indian armed forces, enhancing India's defense capabilities.
 
• The missile system has the potential to be integrated with other defense systems and can be deployed in various terrains, providing flexibility in defense operations.
